headline: 🔴 Adobe patches StyleSmuggler CVSS 10.0, 🎯 BigBear AiTM PaaS bypasses MFA at 258 orgs, 🧩 Coder module registry hijack steals credentials, 💀 Panzer Ransomware emerges with cross-platform payloads, 🪱 Shai-Hulud npm worm returns after 111-day dormancy, 🔐 F5 BIG-IP fileless backdoor enters CISA KEV
summary: Adobe shipped an emergency hotfix for the Magento StyleSmuggler zero-day (CVE-2026-75650, CVSS 10.0) but compromise hunts remain mandatory; CloudSEK exposed BigBear 2.0, an Evilginx2-based MFA-bypass PaaS that hit 258 organizations; the Coder module registry was hijacked to serve credential-stealing packages; new RaaS entrant Panzer targets Windows, Linux, ESXi, and FreeBSD; Shai-Hulud npm worm resurfaced with a known payload hash that bypassed registry screening; and F5 BIG-IP fileless backdoor PoisonedRefresh entered CISA KEV.
